ignored_packages.flet_ads: Advertising controls are not exposed by the Ruflet DSL.
ignored_packages.flet_color_pickers: Color-picker extension controls are not exposed by the Ruflet DSL.
ignored_packages.flet_datatable2: DataTable2 is not exposed by the Ruflet DSL; Ruflet exposes the core DataTable.
ignored_packages.flet_spinkit: Ruflet consolidates Flet's per-animation extension types into the RufletSpinKit wire control.

declared_baseline.reason: All remaining upstream type/event/method records are explicitly classified as outside the Ruflet public DSL, source-extractor sibling leakage, or a documented Apple host limitation. Any change requires conformance review.

RichAttribution.reason: Ruflet does not expose Flet Map's RichAttribution or its extension-only attribution child wire types.

Tester.reason: Flet's internal Tester service is not part of the Ruflet public DSL.

Page.reason: The current Apple host has no NavigationStack pop handshake; this is explicitly platform-unsupported until host navigation owns view popping.

SnackBar.reason: The source extractor sees SnackBarAction.triggerEvent in snack_bar.dart; click belongs to the nested SnackBarAction, not the SnackBar parent.

Tab.reason: The source extractor attributes Tabs/TabBar sibling events from tabs.dart to structural Tab; Tab itself emits no events.

View.reason: The current Apple host has no NavigationStack pop handshake; this is explicitly platform-unsupported until host navigation owns view popping.

Tab.reason: The source extractor attributes the sibling Tabs invoke listener from tabs.dart to structural Tab; Tab has no invoke method listener.
